Shadow Link's Awakening (Sword Slasher RPG)

Top-down 2D action-RPG simulation and React front-end driven by decoupled BEJSON 105 data schemas and the Sword_Slasher_Engine_JS runtime.

Architecture Highlights

  • Data-Driven Engine: Zero-hardcoded game entities, maps, combat stats, and loot tables powered by BEJSON 105.
  • Multi-Engine Portability: Shared BEJSON 105 data contract across multiple engine targets.
  • Live Deployment: Hosted on Cloudflare Pages with companion technical teardowns across CMS, Blogger, and Substack.
